== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An [[Archlord]] [[revelation]] is a personal oath that an individual dedicates themselves to with complete honesty and sincerity. This commitment defines their future path and serves as a core component of reaching the [[Archlord]] stage of power. Because these revelations are tied to an individual's future, they can be altered if the original path is found to be unsatisfactory. Reaching this level of strength allows a practitioner to sense [[Icons]] more clearly and potentially endure the sight of [[Abidan symbols]].}}
